decisions.reason: White-label test pressings are limited-run collector items that draw on the firm's in-house label and vinyl expertise, so the firm can read collector demand well and sustain the series cheaply, though limited editions often rotate out quickly.

A compilation series sits squarely within the firm's core competence in catalog curation, licensing and its in-house label, so it can absorb customer feedback and keep extending the series at low risk.
